description: Ayurveda Medical Council - The Ayurveda Act. No 31 of 1961, the Ayurvedic Officers and Servants (Conditions of Service) Rules No. 01 of  2023
categorisation: This gazette contains rules made by the Ayurvedic Medical Council under the Ayurveda Act, No. 31 of 1961. It establishes regulatory requirements, qualifications, and procedures for the appointment and service conditions of the Registrar and other officers of the Council. This content falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
